fields.summary: Crash in MemoryManager::collectFromJSStack() for a derived class without a constructor (regression from the QTBUG-151273 fix)

content.text: While testing the fix for QTBUG-151273 (7d5e24963a on 6.12, 65c743820a on dev) in our application, we hit new crashes in some situations, so we looked into it. The analysis of the cause below was done with AI (Claude). The reproducer and the effect of the one-line fix were verified by running them.
A derived class without its own constructor crashes when the GC scans the stack while the base constructor runs:
Reproduction(6.12.0 doesn’t have such problem, just unreleased 6.12.1)
gc() only makes it deterministic. Any allocation in the base constructor can trigger the GC, so a plain class MyError extends Error {} created in a loop crashes as well.

#0  QV4::Function::isGenerator                 qv4function_p.h:125
#1  QV4::MemoryManager::collectFromJSStack      qv4mm.cpp:1506
#2  QV4::(anonymous namespace)::markJSStack
#3  QV4::GCStateMachine::transition
...
#10 QV4::DefaultClassConstructorFunction::virtualCallAsConstructor

Probable cause: DefaultClassConstructorFunction::virtualCallAsConstructor() pushes a JSTypesStackFrame with v4Function == nullptr (frame.init(nullptr, argv, argc), qv4functionobject.cpp:673). The fix made collectFromJSStack() call frame->v4Function->isGenerator() for every JS frame. Before, it skipped JS frames without reading v4Function.

--- a/src/qml/memory/qv4mm.cpp
+++ b/src/qml/memory/qv4mm.cpp
@@ void MemoryManager::collectFromJSStack(MarkStack *markStack) const
-            if (frame->v4Function->isGenerator())
+            if (frame->v4Function && frame->v4Function->isGenerator())
A deterministic autotest for tst_qv4mm is attached (autotest.cpp, same style as generatorFrameMarking).

The fix was also picked to lts-6.8 (6.8.10), please check it there. It also relies on 8a8473f70d ("Check stack limits early in GeneratorObject"). Without that commit, a stack overflow inside a generator call leaves a dangling frame, which collectFromJSStack() now reads.

resolution.description: A fix for this issue is checked into the tree and tested.
resolution.name: Fixed
